positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
• Gathered, documented, and verified requirements for development of new systems and processes that resulted in a 20% process effectiveness increase.
• Developed financial models and conducted research to generate insights and recommend solutions to improve operational efficiency and align with the overall strategic vision.
•Supported VP and other Executive leadership in strategic execution of new initiatives, product launches, and ad hoc data requests that directly impact over 700 staff.
• Conduct research, product discovery, requirements review, planning and deployment of new projects that were given to team to lead. 
• Multiple inter-department collaborations with agile execution of project lifecycles to deliver results in timely manner.
•  Created comprehensive business intelligence spans and automated processes to improve data accuracy, minimize manual efforts and deliver insights to enable business decisions.

positions.title: Software QA Tester
positions.description:
• Continuous User Acceptance Testing of business technologies related to payment processing systems, digital wallets, and ATM's serving a 1.3 million card portfolio.
• Active engagement in vendor management and procurement of future projects implementation, delivery and support .
• Managed proof of concept and delivery of  instant issuance card printers project across 50 locations, maintaining active communication between cross-functional teams and vendors for implementation and troubleshooting, analyzing and providing feedback to management on outcomes of project findings.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
-Scrum Agile Development with 1 week sprints
- Sprint Planning, Stories and Epics controlled using MeisterTask
- Continuous Integration control with CircleCI
-Collaborated with multiple developers remotely
- Polished UX/UI structure for a fluid user flow
-Developed Back End routing and database structures to implement new data types
-Adapted to new technologies and languages quickly learning development style of team
-Created new Front End designs to include new data types and structures
-Meteor.js Based Development, involving Mongo, Semantic UI, Express, Node, React
-Added additional database structures, and API route calls to support a growing data need
-Version Control using Git, reviewing, testing and Merging collaborator Pull Requests
-Participated in weekly Stand-up meeting, resolve bugs, conflicts, discuss burndown rate, speed of development, and next steps to shipping product
positions.insights: Skills: Key Performance Indicators · Documentation · Tech-savvy

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Built Full Stack Web Applications using MERN framework
- Curated custom tools for Current and Prospective Students, sharing links and resources for future reference
- Demonstrated Front End and Back End Knowledge Using ASP.Net JavaScript Frameworks Including HTML, CSS, jQuery, MySQL, React, Express, Node, MongoDB
- Maintained Organized Continuous Code Integration using Version Control through GitHub
- Hosted Multiple applications via web hosting Services such as Firebase and Heroku
- Integrated RESTful API's, working with Spotify, Twitter, NewYork TImes, Giphy, Slack, Twilio, and more.
- Managed Group Projects, leading sprints and moderating progress through Project Management Platform Trello, supporting colleagues in resolving issues and ensuring timely deliverables at sprint due date

company.name: University of California, Irvine Division of Continuing Education

positions.title: Credit Analyst/Underwriter - Consumer Lending
positions.description:
-Involved in software testing of new updates to ensure new roll out of updates are properly functioning
-Review of $1 million+ in monthly loan volume
-Provide senior management with reports of impact of delinquency and potential fraud risk
-Mitigate loss exposure through evaluation of past and present processes, recommending corrective action to implement and improve
-Proactive approach to identifying future issues that may come from process and other business practices
-Process development for procedure of fraudulent loans to be repurchased by investors
-Risk review through loans audit after closing
-Consult and support coaching of other junior colleagues in complex underwriting situations and documentation
-Adapt to evolving policies and quickly implement new processes


Evaluating the accuracy of loan documents


Perform manual underwriting of personal loans in accordance with company policies and procedures.


Supporting Wholesale Mortgage Underwriting
-Clearing Mortgage conditions to support Loan Approval
-Experience with General Underwriting process
-Working Knowledge of Desktop Underwriter (DU) and Loan Prospector (LP)
-Reviewing Mortgage applications and documents to ensure they meet regulatory compliance

positions.title: Consumer Lending Group Intern, Business Operations Risk
positions.description:
Reviewed booked auto loans for risk of aftermarket products finance, to comply with internal and external policies, implemented new policies and training opportunities to share with various departments using Credit Revue, FileNet, iTop

Acted as loan document specialist, funding Fleet and Business Loans, funding a volume of over $250,000, logging incoming loans into multiple business applications as Fleet Financial Services (FFS), Credit Revue  (CRS)

Identified potential business risk aftermarket products  to comply with regulation, analyzed data using excel data, reducing risk of exposure and loss with aftermarket products sold.

Collaborated on group project with various lines of business across multiple states, researching analytics on LinkedIn, and provided feedback and suggested programs to implement based on findings

projects.title: Slack Overflow
projects.description:
Problem solving application, ensuring links and resources shared by classmates didn't disappear in inaccessible messages caused by Slack Messaging limit. Myself and four classmates worked to integrate Slack API routing, and Twilio (SMS) routing, so that all resources via Slack or mobile, would be stored, and accessible at all times. Technologies/Frameworks used: Node.js, MySQL, Slack API, Twilio API, Bootstrap, jQuery.
-Future enhancements include: Multi-User platform with authentication. Admin Setup for multi workspace configuration, and delegation of permissible use.

projects.title: Enablr - Local Meetup Application
projects.description: Resource application that provide local Tech Meet-ups based on the city searched. Application was created so that current and future students had a simple way to identify Meet-ups and social events that could help them grow their career network, and learn of new technologies.
